description: Free "membership card": register your agent and get a caller_id. Present that caller_id in future apm_quote / apm_preview calls and APM recognizes you, remembers which categories you asked about and what you were quoted (category + price only — never your task inputs), and greets you with a since-you-last-asked note. No wallet and no payment needed. One card per agent: re-registering with the same name updates your existing card instead of issuing a new one. This tool is free and never executes a purchase. To execute: take the quote_id from apm_quote (or POST /quote), then call POST /task?quote=<quote_id> and pay customer_price in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402. Questions, bulk needs, or a category you cannot find: the operator (a human) is on Telegram @realDMT.

contact.description: Optional: how the operator can reach you or your operator

endpoint.description: Optional: your own service endpoint (MCP or API URL), if you run one — our operator may visit it (read-only) to understand what you do

looking_for.description: What you shop for (categories, data types, volume) — helps APM stock what you need

referred_by.description: Optional: who sent you — another agent's caller_id or name; referrals get counted

name: apm_register
